summary: Saint Louis County lookout photographed in 1940 and captioned razed in 2019; a local listing says the Skibo Vista overlook near Hoyt Lakes was once home to a fire tower, but no source ties that tower to the lookout.

facts.status_note: Described as razed in a 2019 study's photo caption; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

access.note: The Skibo Vista overlook near Hoyt Lakes needs no admission or permit, except for trips into the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness. A local listing says the overlook was once home to a fire tower; no source gives dates or confirms the lookout's exact site.

notes_for_editor: No source read gives the build year, builder, staffing or removal date. The tie between the lookout and the Skibo Vista overlook rests on one local listing (ironrange.org) saying the overlook was once home to a fire tower; the city page does not mention a tower. Unopened search snippets, not cited: a geocache for Skibo Vista (GCJ8CJ) reportedly describes tower pilings, but the cached page returned only its title; a 2025 wildfire photo caption reportedly names a 'Skibo Lookout Tower', which would conflict with 'razed' and should be checked. The geocache snippet puts the overlook about ten miles southeast of Hoyt Lakes, while the city page says just outside. The record point is about 6 km from the Wikipedia community coordinates (47.48556, -91.99444). The 2016 Skibo Fire is left out because no source ties it to the tower. The 1940 photo is embedded in the 2019 PDF with no direct image URL, so no photo entry.
